notes: SPRINT-21 adoption, full scope in one sprint (docs/LANGUAGES.md C++ section): all eleven passes enabled -- the SEVENTH full-scope pack, closing wave-2. The pinned tree-sitter-cpp v0.23.4 grammar (the MAIN org, the same version number as the C pin) inlines the full C grammar at generation time and ships an external scanner (src/scanner.c: raw strings, angle-bracket disambiguation). Symbols: function DEFINITIONS with a body anywhere -- free functions, inline and out-of-class methods, constructors, destructors (the as-written ~X spelling), operator overloads (the as-written operator== spelling), templated functions (template_declaration wraps the definition) -- the name resolved by the declarator-chain walk (the C walk extended: field_identifier members, qualified_identifier name field, destructor_name/operator_name as-written; never guessed). Prototypes and member declarations are NOT symbols (the C discipline; the definition normally exists in the same root). Lambdas are anonymous constructs: NOT symbols, their decisions count inward. Decision table: C's (if_statement with else-if nested, while/do/for, case_statement WITH the value field -- a default arm is the same node WITHOUT it, the gocyclo discipline; the ternary conditional_expression) PLUS for_range_loop (the C++11 range-for is its OWN node type) and catch_clause; && and || inside the shared binary_expression container; preprocessor conditionals are NOT decisions. Resolver v1-cpp: the C include channel SHARED unchanged (quoted -> the including file's directory, angle -> system, never resolves; a macro path records NOTHING; the imports relation is a SET); the using family (using_declaration, alias_declaration, using-directive, namespace aliases) records NOTHING in v1 -- no honest file mapping exists without a manifest, none is invented. NO mate marking (link order is not a parse fact). OC005 marking: an include binds NULL -- a whole-file claim (the Ruby require discipline). Entry points: EMPTY manifest list BY DESIGN -- the entry claim is the PARSE FACT of a free-standing function DEFINITION named main (the Q_CPP_MAIN fact, the Q_C_MAIN query text verified against the cpp grammar by the adoption probe; the identifier-only inner declarator keeps C++ member functions and out-of-class definitions out); entry_points is empty because no basename glob can express 'defines main'. .h ROUTING (the approved C/C++ architecture decision, implemented this sprint): BOTH the c and cpp packs claim .h; a .h file routes through the CONTENT SNIFF (clean cpp parse carrying a C++-distinctive node -> cpp; cpp parse errors with a clean C parse -> c) and otherwise the PROJECT-ROOT DEFAULT (cpp iff the discovered set carries at least one non-.h cpp-pack extension, else c); the counts land in the report meta header_routing block -- never silent; a no-backend build sniffs inconclusive and the root default decides. Until this sprint every .h was C (the documented SPRINT-20 boundary); the C pack's extension list is unchanged. Test conventions: none registered in v1 (no runner-executed C++ convention is name-pinned). OC007 fires with a Cobertura-shaped XML via --coverage; gcovr emits Cobertura XML natively for C++ projects (the same reader as C); lcov tracefiles are out of scope v1. Supply tier (the honest delineation, SPRINT-21): C++ has NO canonical dependency manifest reader in v1 -- OC009 and OC010 are enabled pack data but nothing is ever discovered for them (no fabricated pkg-config/vcpkg/conan tier: a versionless include is not a pin and a vendored tree is not a manifest); without their inputs the passes produce nothing and the report meta says so (manifests_scanned: 0). No OSV ecosystem exists for C++ includes and none is invented. OC010's licence-file probe is a manifest-reader convention and is deferred with the same rationale. Metaprogramming (templates, macros, token pasting) is a parse fact only as far as the grammar sees it -- the Rust macro boundary, accepted in the over-report direction for OC006. As-written analysis: no preprocessing; conditional-compilation variants are reported as the single parsed configuration.
